## About

Rex Sitti is an Assistant Professor of Economics in the Strome College of Business at Old Dominion University, where he also contributes to the Dragas Center for Economic Analysis and Policy. His research spans urban economics, housing policy, homelessness, coastal flooding, and safety net programs. He joined the ODU faculty in Fall 2024 and previously held positions at the University of New Mexico, Michigan State University, and the University of Memphis. He holds a PhD from the University of New Mexico, an MBA from the University of Memphis, and a BCom from Kenyatta University.

## Contact Policy

Students should feel welcome to contact me via email at [rsitti\@odu.edu](mailto:rsitti@odu.edu){.email} or drop by Zoom office hours. I strongly encourage students to communicate with me. I will try to answer emails within 48 business hours (often much sooner) for course related topics.

Students should take the time to craft complete, professional emails. The more information that you can provide about a question or problem, the more likely that my response will be helpful. Avoid non-professional language and practice communicating in the corporate workplace.

Students should proactively address issues with the class and scheduling rather than waiting until an assignment is overdue. In many cases, accommodations can be made for 'life events,' however, clear and prompt communication is necessary.
